genres.theme: Family secrets, marriage conflict, betrayal, inheritance, hidden documents, security cameras, hospitals, banks, old promises, custody disputes, private messages, funeral secrets, property deeds, and workplace lies affecting family life.
genres.globalStyle: Original first-person emotional family drama for social media readers. Short paragraphs. Strong hook. Slow reveal. Domestic clues, believable family conflict, and a final twist that reinterprets earlier details.
genres.avoid: No supernatural plots. No graphic violence. No explicit sex. No real public figures. Do not copy existing article premises.

genres.theme: Inheritance disputes, forged documents, wills, bank statements, property deeds, notarized letters, hidden accounts, old family promises, and relatives fighting over money or a house.
genres.globalStyle: First-person suspense built around physical evidence. Focus on documents, signatures, dates, bank records, property records, and a family reveal that changes who deserves trust.
genres.avoid: No supernatural plots. No courtroom technical lectures. No copied article premises. No real public figures.

genres.theme: Divorce, ex-husband, ex-wife, ex-mother-in-law, blocked cards, rent payments, custody disputes, family pressure, old bank statements, and a confrontation at the door.
genres.globalStyle: Fast emotional first-person story with a sharp opening conflict, escalating confrontation, and a document or message that exposes why the ex-family is desperate.
genres.avoid: No explicit sex. No graphic violence. No real public figures. Do not copy the reference article plot or wording.

genres.theme: Parents humiliating a child, siblings compared unfairly, graduation scenes, family microphones, birthday speeches, favoritism, hidden adoption records, and a painful truth revealed later.
genres.globalStyle: Emotional first-person family drama focused on shame, memory, silence, and a reveal that explains years of unfair treatment.
genres.avoid: No supernatural plots. No graphic abuse detail. No copied article premise. No real public figures.

genres.theme: Workplace humiliation, rich spouse, employee accused unfairly, company party, private messages, HR emails, security footage, inheritance money, and a public accusation that backfires.
genres.globalStyle: Dramatic social-media fiction with a strong public humiliation hook, power imbalance, receipts, messages, and a twist that exposes the real manipulator.
genres.avoid: No explicit sex. No graphic violence. No real public figures or real companies. Keep every character fictional.

genres.theme: Football family drama, club pressure, player contracts, youth academy secrets, injury paperwork, transfer rumors, angry fans, family sacrifice, and a public accusation connected to a match.
genres.globalStyle: Fictional football-focused drama with match-day tension, family stakes, club politics, social-media pressure, and a document/message reveal. Use fictional clubs and players unless real-news mode is added later.
genres.avoid: Do not invent claims about real players, real clubs, or real matches. No graphic violence. No copied news article.

genres.theme: Human-interest news style, neighborhood disputes, family conflict, public embarrassment, documents, community rumors, official-looking notices, and a surprising personal truth.
genres.globalStyle: News-like but fictional human-interest story. Keep the pacing clear, factual-sounding, and emotionally readable while avoiding real people or unverifiable claims.
genres.avoid: No real public figures. Do not present fiction as real news. No copied article premise.
